frozen_criteria.description: fractional-flow 곡선을 직선으로 가정할 때, 다중 유체 흐름 시스템에서의 상대 투과도( Relative Permeability )가 단일 직선 관계로 표현되어야 한다.
물전선 속도 계산에 사용되는 fractional-flow 곡선의 기울기는 상대 투과도의 변화에 따라 일정하게 유지되어야 한다.
유체의 상대 투과도는 압력 변화에 따라 비선형적으로 변하는 것이 아니라, 선형적으로 변한다고 가정해야 한다.
모든 유체 상호작용이 물전선 이동 속도에 직접적인 영향을 주며, 이 영향은 단순한 선형 관계로 모델링되어야 한다.
모델링된 fractional-flow 곡선은 실제 시스템의 물전선 이동 속도를 정확하게 반영할 수 있는 수치적 증거를 제공해야 한다.

8.3. SINGLE PHASE FLOW
8.3.1. Uniform Vertical Permeability
In order to appreciate the significance of pressure data in developed reservoirs it is 
useful to consider some relatively straight-forward situations which often arise in 
practice.  Consider first the case illustrated in Figure 6 where a new well - to become 
an edge water injector - has been drilled into the aquifer of a producing field.  Due to 
oil production from central wells and subsequent pressure depletion in the reservoir 
the aquifer is expanding into the oil zone as shown i.e. natural water drive is taking 
place.  Thus in the vicinity of the observation well water is moving updip and the 
local water flux has both a vertical and a horizontal component; from the point 
of view of WFT pressure interpretation it is the vertical component of the water 
flux, denoted uzw, which is important.  The vertical components of the flux and the 
potential gradient are related by D’Arcy’s law:

8.8.1. PARTIALLY COMMUNICATING FAULTS
The areal variation of formation pressure during the period of appraisal development 
reflects the continuity in the reservoir.  In particular the degree of communication 
across faults, whose presence usually will have been shown up by seismic and 
logging surveys, can be investigated.  In order to develop a quantitative interpretation 
it is necessary to have a model which describes the effect of non-sealing faults 
on reservoir flow.  In order to have a partially communicating fault it is usually 
necessary to have juxtaposition or connection as illustrated in Figure 39.  If there 
is no juxtaposition it is normally assumed that the fault is sealing.  Note that in 
optimum conditions a displacement must be greater than about 60 ft for it to be 
evident on seismic.  However it must be said that field examples occur where fault 
planes act as open fractures of high conductivity.  For example an offshore field 
in Brazil exhibited entirely unexpected (and very welcome) pressure maintenance 
from natural water influx when no aquifer was seen in direct communication with 
the field.  Examination of the well tests showed derivative rollover c
lcome) pressure maintenance 
from natural water influx when no aquifer was seen in direct communication with 
the field.  Examination of the well tests showed derivative rollover consistent with 
a distant (non-intersecting) open fracture and the reservoir structure illustrated in 
Figure 40 was inferred.  The open fault plane was apparently acting as a conduit for 
water influx from a deeper aquifer.

frozen_criteria.description: fractional-flow 곡선을 직선으로 가정할 때, 다중 유체 흐름 시스템에서의 상대 투과도( Relative Permeability )가 단일 직선 관계로 표현되어야 한다.
물전선 속도 계산에 사용되는 fractional-flow 곡선의 기울기는 상대 투과도의 변화에 따라 일정하게 유지되어야 한다.
유체의 상대 투과도는 압력 변화에 따라 비선형적으로 변하는 것이 아니라, 선형적으로 변한다고 가정해야 한다.
모든 유체 상호작용이 물전선 이동 속도에 직접적인 영향을 주며, 이 영향은 단순한 선형 관계로 모델링되어야 한다.
모델링된 fractional-flow 곡선은 실제 시스템의 물전선 이동 속도를 정확하게 반영할 수 있는 수치적 증거를 제공해야 한다.

8.8.1. PARTIALLY COMMUNICATING FAULTS
The areal variation of formation pressure during the period of appraisal development 
reflects the continuity in the reservoir.  In particular the degree of communication 
across faults, whose presence usually will have been shown up by seismic and 
logging surveys, can be investigated.  In order to develop a quantitative interpretation 
it is necessary to have a model which describes the effect of non-sealing faults 
on reservoir flow.  In order to have a partially communicating fault it is usually 
necessary to have juxtaposition or connection as illustrated in Figure 39.  If there 
is no juxtaposition it is normally assumed that the fault is sealing.  Note that in 
optimum conditions a displacement must be greater than about 60 ft for it to be 
evident on seismic.  However it must be said that field examples occur where fault 
planes act as open fractures of high conductivity.  For example an offshore field 
in Brazil exhibited entirely unexpected (and very welcome) pressure maintenance 
from natural water influx when no aquifer was seen in direct communication with 
the field.  Examination of the well tests showed derivative rollover c
lcome) pressure maintenance 
from natural water influx when no aquifer was seen in direct communication with 
the field.  Examination of the well tests showed derivative rollover consistent with 
a distant (non-intersecting) open fracture and the reservoir structure illustrated in 
Figure 40 was inferred.  The open fault plane was apparently acting as a conduit for 
water influx from a deeper aquifer.
